requirements.text: You have 4-8 years of industry experience, and are excited about learning new technologies and applying them in a fast-changing environment. Please note this is not a new grad position.
You have experience in areas such as databases, distributed systems, service-oriented architectures, and data infrastructure.
You have a strong background in computer science with a degree in CS or a related field.
You are currently based or willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area.
Proactively identify and lead significant improvements to Airtable’s infrastructure, working across teams and product areas to maximize business and engineering impact.
Work on systems-level problems in a complex design space where scalability, efficiency, reliability, and security really matter.
You derive joy from refactoring and building clean abstractions in order to make complex systems fun to develop on and easy to understand.
Take full ownership of components of Airtable’s infrastructure, including responsibility for reliability, performance, efficiency, and observability of our production environment.

Traffic: We are looking for founding members of our Traffic Engineering team. We recently formed a Traffic Infrastructure team to ensure that traffic across Airtable’s network and routing infrastructure is managed in a reliable, flexible, and secure manner. Some the upcoming work in this team's charter include supporting improved performance in our secondary regions (like EU), bolstering our rate limiting and admission control infrastructure, and creating a consolidated and unified stateless route execution platform. We are looking for software engineers experienced in areas of API gateway (Envoy/Nginx/Pingora), edge networking like CDN/WAF, and stateless request serving platforms.
